sources.title: Neko Health raises $700m Series C ahead of US launch

sources.title: Full-body scan startup Neko Health scores $700M to break into the U.S. market
claims: Neko Health $700M Series C confirmed — largest round in DTC preventive scanning category

Company founded 2018, launched publicly 2023 after 4 years of hardware development
Neko scan price: ~$400/visit
Scan time: ~10 minutes, 500+ health markers, no ionizing radiation

sources.title: Function Health buys Ezra, launches full-body scan for a third of the price

Price reduced from $1,500 to $499 for full-body AI MRI
Combines Ezra's imaging with Function Health's 100+ blood biomarker testing
Largest single price reduction in DTC preventive scanning history

Neko Health 'ahead overall'; Prenuvo 'clear leader in dedicated whole-body MRI'
